integrity: The proof uses true-twin triangle pairs and false-twin pendant leaves to obtain sharp lower bounds, then classifies every equality case. The exceptional three-horn triangle is handled by an exhaustive two-vertex type analysis. The finite-ring application is a direct substitution into the published Yu–Wu classification.
scientific_limitations: The ring application is restricted to finite commutative rings whose annihilating-ideal graph has core consisting only of triangles.
The complete zero forcing polynomial is not determined.
The formulas classify graphs and minimum forcing sets, not ring isomorphism types realizing the same graph.
Related ordinary zero forcing values for generalized windmills exist in later literature; the strengthened content is the mixed horn family, exact minimizer classification, and Yu–Wu specialization.
title: Minimum zero forcing sets of triangle-core annihilating-ideal graphs
